## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      7 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 2, 2026 - Sep 16, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Brian Dowd_, Sep 16, 2026, 1/5: "This used to be a solid app, but has been ruined by an extractive tech company after it was acquired in 2022. It is now bloated with mediocre features that slow it down. The paid version has ridiculously steep and aggressive subscription costs, and the free version is marred with RELENTLESS ads that ruin the user experience. I've been using this app for years but the frustrations have built up to the point where it is almost unusable. I'm so fed up that I'm taking my notes to another app."
            2. _Tom C_, Sep 16, 2026, 2/5: "This was a great app, until they added forced video adverts. Now it's pretty much unusable. Let's be honest, it's an app for making notes, if they make it a chore to use, there are plenty of alternatives."
            3. _AmmiM10_, Aug 2, 2026, 2/5: "I used to be a big fan of this app, but since the last update, many features have stopped working properly. For example, collapsing and expanding items is broken, and the item editing experience on mobile has become terrible. I really hope these issues are fixed soon because I'm close to canceling my subscription."
